page_title: PAR 2-3 ROM | Parma v AS Roma 10/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+14' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+13' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
90+13' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniele Chiffi stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. AS Roma have a free kick.
90+11' 2 - 3 Goal! Donyell Malen (AS Roma) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Zion Suzuki into left side of the goal.
90+11' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) is going to take the penalty!

90+9' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Daniele Chiffi shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
90+9' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to AS Roma!

90+8' Play continues despite the shouts by some AS Roma players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+7' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90+4' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Daniele Ghilardi provided an assist for the goal.
90+4' The referee awards a corner and Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) goes over to take it.
90+2' AS Roma fail to score from a corner as Zion Suzuki (Parma) leaps to collect the ball.

90+2' A sweet pass finds Wesley Franca (AS Roma) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Zion Suzuki is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play. AS Roma win a corner kick.
90+1' AS Roma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and AS Roma will take a corner.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

87' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Mandela Keita (Parma) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Nahuel Estevez. The score is now 2:1.
84' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

84' Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
81' The free kick from long range, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for an infringement. Parma have a free kick.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is brought on as a substitute for Nesta Elphege.
79' Carlos Cuesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Estevez (Parma) replacing Hans Nicolussi Caviglia.
78' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
77' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. AS Roma will take a corner kick.
77' The free kick is delivered by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
76' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) gets a yellow card.
75' Here is a change. Manu Kone is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma).
75' Here comes a substitution. Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Zeki Celik.
74' Substitution. Enrico Delprato makes his way off the pitch and Sascha Britschgi (Parma) comes on as his replacement.
74' It will be a substitution. Franco Carboni (Parma) is ready to enter the pitch as Emanuele Valeri walks off.

73' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Zion Suzuki is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
72' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
69' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Daniele Chiffi signals a set piece.
67' Manu Kone (AS Roma) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
65' Mariano Troilo (Parma) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
63' The linesman raises his flag. Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is adjudged offside.
62' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Chiffi no option but to blow his whistle.
61' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Manu Kone (AS Roma) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. AS Roma have a corner.
60' Christian Ordonez (Parma) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
59' Here comes a substitution. Bryan Cristante is given a rest as he is replaced by Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma).
58' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Matias Soule and he is replaced by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma).
56' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
56' Parma force a corner. They send men into the box.
54' Enrico Delprato (Parma) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee signals a corner kick to Parma.
53' That will be all from Mario Hermoso who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma).
53' Mateo Pellegrino comes onto the pitch because Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.

51' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Donyell Malen (AS Roma) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Zion Suzuki pulls off a brilliant save.
48' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

47' 1 - 1 Goal! Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) neatly controls a decent pass from Hans Nicolussi Caviglia. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. 1:1.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Chiffi starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.
42' The resulting corner from Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) is cleared by the defence.
41' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Corner kick. Parma will have an opportunity.
36' Flag goes up against Emanuele Valeri (Parma) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
35' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
34' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
31' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
29' Matias Soule (AS Roma) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!
26' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
26' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Emanuele Valeri (Parma). Daniele Chiffi saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.

22' 0 - 1 Stunning strike! Donyell Malen (AS Roma) latches on to a precise through ball from Paulo Dybala before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 0:1.
21' Matias Soule (AS Roma) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
20' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
15' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
14' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) brings his opponent down. Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
13' Nesta Elphege (Parma) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
9' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Donyell Malen (AS Roma) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
8' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Matias Soule (AS Roma) heads on.
4' That's a well-taken pass by Gabriel Strefezza (Parma). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
3' Nesta Elphege (Parma) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
2' It looks like Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Chiffi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Daniele Chiffi.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
